summary: The write path now rechecks candidate expiry immediately before applying the repair, and a focused test verifies stale candidates are refused.

evidence: scripts/codex-auth-repair.ts captures writeNowMs after candidate assessment and refuses the write when applyCodexAuthPlan reports a stale plan.
src/codex/auth-repair.ts rejects any selected candidate whose access_exp_ms is at or before the write-time clock.
tests/codex-auth-repair.test.ts verifies a candidate expiring between planning and application returns null and leaves the pool unchanged.
